content: Rodia Petrus nora Yohansi la o'ta-mat agama gaini
La'pa Petrus nora Yohansi raltiertier mia'ta dewade imam-imam re ror mak khi' o'tani la mak katiaka Uplerlawna roma kreini, me riy makden Saduki rma rawenan la Petrus nor Yohansi.
Rawenan la yoma rrora rwatutu-rwaye'a Yesus lirni-tunnu, ne riwra Yesus Nmori owa'an la matmiatni ralamni pede hota mak kmati olekwa mana hota rmori owa'ana.
La'a lir de, pede rte'la la rrora pa rla rwi'ita la roma nhio'la. Ne yoma rtorna rrora de lera nmel olek wa, pede rwei pia repra nanpena rwalol nohora.
Mere riy mak kpesiay olek makodia Uplerlawna lir kalwiedni wniatutnu-wniaye'eni de, de edonna nhal de riy riwnu wolima.
Repar noma mak ktorna agama watghudi, de Yahudi in letni-am letni, rora makwatutu-kwaye'a agama, rawok momuou lia Yerusalem.
Imam o'ta lawanni Hanas me, e huwnu-woinni de Kayafas, Yohansi, Aleksander, me huwnu-woinni dom pali, er wal lia hande.
Ir rodia Petrus nora Yohansi la hare gaini, na'nama ratiana irrora: “Ee, mimrio'a mhi' emkameni pede riy maka inonni kmat die nkalwieda? He' mak kala ruri-lai tiy miy pede mhi' hadena?”
Petrus mak Uplerlawna Nhiw Lululli Nodi plolli la, nakot la re: “U'pu-matro'mu mak kodi plolli la Yahudi ita, me la' wali u'pu-matro'mu korni mak ktorna agama watghudni.

U'pu-matro'mu mak khopan pa a'ultieri pede reiniande awualol nohora hihi' mamni-yapyap miamni. Miodi am lia watghudi lokarni me tatiaili pniarni, yoma la'a kalwied mamni la amhi' kalwieda mak inonni kmati. Ne u'pu-matro'mu riwra ratian walia pa rat niohora la emkameni riy de nkalwied la mehrani-maunu.

Hade pede a'ukota hadi, totpa u'pu-matro'mu la'pa Israel wal miana, miy hononmi miatga, riy di naprir lia it gaini la dodo'ondi, de onnila ruri-lai me plola-mneha Yesus Kristusa riy Nasaret de. U'pu-matro'mu hononmi er mak kakot pa rla rwairia E la auwlakar de. Mere Uplerlawna Nmeh'a Namori owa'ana la'a matmiatni ralamni.
Yesus de inhatta, maka ha rakotkota la Puklawna ralamni de emkadilla lirni:

content.text: “Wat muaka tukna-tukna miy edonna mniair nana pa mhi'a roma-lewu, mere misrala, de Uplerlawna Nnairia olek pa Nhi'a la watu liar pianulu.”

content: La'pa he'a maka klernohora Yesus, de talla kmeh'a inhatta pa tler la mormiori-dardiar plalahwa ralamni. Yoma la'a noheri woru-lyanti nayan di, eneknek to'a Yesus Nmeh'a maka Uplerlawna Ntutmuata-nkewra'a pa Namori-nalewna rimormiori ita.”

Makhudi-makpara honona re rwarora-rwalaiya, de Petrus nora Yohansi parania la ltierni-tianni re, emkameni ho'mana edon la' meman la iskola, nhi'nande hare ema rtaplelleltarga. Makhudi re rwaror owa'ana, de irrora ratu raltieri-raltiani yoma nhi'inde ror oleka Yesus pa rlidan wutu.
Ne ramkek rer miemna riy mak kalwied olek la nnieni-nhien de, e ntutrieri lia honona re gaini ralamni, pede ir edonna rhi'a kokokna-rariarni doma.
Noma rhopan pa Petrus nora Yohansi rlergot la hande totpena o'ta-mata re rakot nohora hya'a mak hota rhi'a.

Nhor nioka idma nakot la ida: “Hota itakota hya'a la ha rora? Yerusalem uhunu-riwriwni rat momuog oleka la irrora mak khi' nana hihi'a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona (mujizat) mak riy edon ramkek taru, pa nhi'nande riy honona ema rtaplelleltarga. It edonna treher doinia hade.
Mere totpa la'pa mak ha rhi' nana la riy di yana nwewar la noheri woru, de mai pia takot la irrora totpena yan memmemna rrora rakot nohora Yesus la he'a-he'a.”
Noma rpolg owa'ana makodia Uplerlawna lir kalwiedni rora, pa rmai owa'an la rialma, ne rwagahniorta re pa, yan memmemna rwatutu-rwaye' de rakot nohora Yesus la he'a-he'a.
Mere Petrusa nora Yohansi rwalolla: “La'a wniaror wamuehemi de, hya'a mak kaplol la Uplerlawna yamkekni? Amlernohor miy me, amlernohora Uplerlawna?
Hota ami edonna mren am lia yaltieri la'a hya' mak amamkek oleka, me hya' maka amatlin oleka.”

Maktorna agama watghudni re honona edonna rlernana talan pa rukmua Petrus nora Yohansi yoma yeher to'a pa riy honona ra'uli-rawedi Uplerlawna. Pede rho'or temna rrora na'nama rwagahniorta, noma rolin doinia rrora la.
Riy honona ratga de, hadi de Uplerlawna hihi'ini-yapyapni yoma riy maka kler olek la kalwieda la mehrani-maunu ralamni de, anni terampwogat rehenu.
Makpesiay honona rwaka ruri-lai la Orgahi-Orha'a
La'pa rolin doinia Petrus nora Yohansi noma, rawali owa'an la mutwualli re, me rwahauru momuoga la'a hya' maka imam-imam o'tani-matni re, rora Yahudi in letni-am letni rakota la ira.

La'pa mutwualli re ratlin ha rakota re, noma honona rewre'wa rsumbain pa rakot la Uplerlawna, riwra: “Matroma! O' ed maka kodi plolli la hanek-harahu wuawannu, O' nanpena ed mak kakoki-kayapi nohkerna-lyanit marna, la'pa gera-tah'i nor wutga ihini-turnu.
O' Nhipmu Napre'et up mamni-tgar mamni ray Daud mak kla' hopopanmu de nurnu, pa Omiwra:

content.text: “Nihya'pa hairi-hairi maka Yahudi atia'a rahankerna, me la'a hya' pede makden Yahudi rna'ohma ha tia'ta'a?
Ray-ray marna-wuhura noha wawannu, me maktorna-makrautu rla' lir id pa ratlinnon keran la Orgahi-Orha'a, me riy maka Ha Nano'targa pa la'a Ray la yamori-yalewna, totpa rora ra'ara!”

content: Maka Daud nakota naplola, yoma la' toto' meman la Herodes me Pontius Pilatus rna'ohma pa rora makden Israel me makden Israel atia'a pa rla' lir ida la'a let di. Rna'ohma la wniatromni pa rlewria Yesus, hopopanmu mak kakleh do'a-hal de, maka Omtiutmuata-mkewra'a oleka la Ray, pa Namori-nalewan rimormiori.
Honona rla' lir id pa rhi'a hya' maka Mula'ul pua Omukot tar oleka pa hota ntutu-nte'ewa. Ne la'pa hya'a maka Mukot taru re de riora-liai wamuehemu la' liwangenmu-mtatangenmu.

Dodo'ondi de ampak de matmu reprepar la tulu lyanti, me tlinmu mana Mhuer tiarga la polpuol muamni. Yan Muolin limmu me, Mpue'er rormu la ami yoma e rna'ohma pa rhi' yatyatni mai ami. Ne Mpualoi-mpuahyaria talla mai hopopanmu ami totpena amparan pia amodia nanmu pa nla nwewar la noha wawannu.

Muala rurmu-laimu mai ami totpena amhi'a riy mak kamehra pa rkalwieda, la'pa amhi'a hihi'a-yapyapi mak kamehi-kayona mak ktutga O rurmu-laimu pede riy ema rtaplelleltarga. Yoma Yesus, hopopanmu mak kakleha do'a-hala de ed mak kodi plolli mai ami.”

La'pa rsumbain pa nhorwua dewade gen miak ha rdella, de nwolwo'la. Uplerlawna Nhiwni Nodi plolli la ira pa Napre'et nurnu-nwaran namni re honona, pa la' pa rakot nohora Uplerlawna lirni de edonna rmakukga (ramta'ata).
Makpesiay re honona rla' ihru ida-ralm ida
Makpesiay honona re rla'a ihru ida-ralm ida. Riy id mana edonna nahora-natawlia ida. Hya' maka riy ida hyonni-hyanni de, honona rnair rewre'wa.

Rnairia plola-mneh lawan de pa makodia Uplerlawna lir kalwiedni ral kota-ral de'et la pa nodi liarni, rakot nohora la'a Itmatromlawanni Yesus de, Nmori olek owa'an la matmiatni ralamni. Ne Uplerlawna Ntera-ndem reri makpesiay honona re.
La'a riy id la ir mana edon nakleha-naplara, yoma la'a ir pa he'a nohananni etla me he'a romni etla, de orgahi na'olga pa weli kupna de, rodia
pa rawoka la makodi Uplerlawna lir kalwiedni re wokni letgara. Nhorwua demade kupan yawoka re ra'ala pa ra rhima-rre'a maka kakleha-kaplara.

Emkade wal lia' Yusup. E' wal pia na'olga nohananni, pa welli de nala la makodia Uplerlawna lir kalwiedni. Yusup de, de riy Lewi ida duratni-waitni mak kwatiawua Siprus. Makodia Uplerlawna lir kalwiedni re, rpolga Yusup de Barnabas, nnia'eratni de mak khi' aruri rira ralamni.
